property_summary: For every admissible input, a call into C's fallback succeeds exactly when msg.value equals 10 ether and block.timestamp strictly exceeds pastBlockTime; the mutant (accepting 1 ether) violates this by succeeding on amounts other than 10 ether and reverting on 10 ether.
change_summary: Change the value requirement from 10 ether to 1 ether, so calls with 1 ether now succeed and calls with 10 ether revert.
